method: Stage-only rerun of the production historical-enrichment function on the original saved 80 headline threads; preserves topics and existing chronology and does not rerun matching.

validation.focusedOldsTests: passed: 18 tests across olds.test.ts and historicalContext.test.ts
validation.liveAudit: completed all 80 threads; no fetch failures

limitations: The limited flag counts distinct dated years earlier than 2021; it does not judge the relevance of every pre-existing root-article chronology entry.
The three-distinct-older-years threshold is a screening heuristic, not an editorial completeness judgment.
Eighteen of the 47 remaining rows have broad country, city, town, or territory roots; these stay limited rather than receiving unrelated place history.
Thirty-three remaining rows have zero eligible older years; eleven have one and three have two.
The sequential v15 and v18 audits used live Wikipedia, so the 10-to-13 expansion-count difference is observational, not a controlled causal score.
The recent-edition bridge path made no measurable difference on this 80-thread set; its service-level mock verifies bounded lookup and source guards.
